text:
sara_ml: Quick bring-up from yesterday's bench. Ran nebula-lite-10b int6 vs int8 on our summarization+chat traces. Short summary: int6 ≈ 2.8x cheaper per token but shows modest QA drop on long-context summarization slices (~3.7% absolute). p50 latency slightly better, p95 increases ~40ms for >1k token requests.

mike_prod: Can you post the raw unit-econ deltas? want per-request numbers for product impact calc.

sara_ml: Baseline nebula-lite-10b int8: cost $0.0095 / 1k tokens, p50 85ms, p95 210ms, QA=82.1. int6: cost $0.0034 / 1k tokens, p50 78ms, p95 250ms, QA=78.4. Numbers from synthetic user-like trace sampling, slice-weighted.

joel_platform: Good savings. Any signal of catastrophic failures or spike in hallucinations?

tina_eval: On long-dialog slice (avg ~1400 tokens) we see more repetition and slight factuality drops. precision@1 down ~4.1% there. Short-turn chat slices look parity. No catastrophic hallucinations observed in the sample.

mike_prod: What fraction of traffic is long-context vs short? helps weight the QA hit.

sara_ml: From the sample: ~19% of requests >1k tokens, ~7% >1.5k. By token-volume long-context (>1k) accounts for ~31% of tokens.

joel_platform: Proposal: context-aware hybrid routing. Serve int6 for requests <=1024 tokens; for 1025-2048 do a small canary; for >2048 keep int8. That preserves most econ wins.

mike_prod: Would product be OK with a canary on the 1k-2k bucket or should we block int6 for those?

sara_ml: My recommendation: default route = int6 for <=1024 tokens. 1025-2048: canary 15% int6 / 85% int8. >2048: int8 only. This hits ~28% token-cost reduction vs all-int8 and estimated ~$12k/mo savings at current spend. Weighted QA impact ≈ -0.6% (within tolerance).

joel_platform: I'll convert that into a routing policy. Example rule snippet: 

```
{
  "route_rules": [
    {"max_tokens":1024, "model":"nebula-lite-10b-int6", "traffic_pct":100},
    {"min_tokens":1025, "max_tokens":2048, "model_pool":[{"model":"nebula-lite-10b-int8","pct":85},{"model":"nebula-lite-10b-int6","pct":15}]},
    {"min_tokens":2049, "model":"nebula-lite-10b-int8", "traffic_pct":100}
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary=15% for 1025-2048 slice, start_time=3425000005, monitors=latency,QA,hallucination_rate.

mike_prod: Define auto-abort thresholds for GTN: abort if weighted QA delta >2.5% OR hallucination alerts +30% OR p95 latency +20%. ok?

tina_eval: LGTM. Also request a manual 24h qualitative QC (1k sample) in addition to heuristics — I'll post findings in this thread.

joel_platform: I'll wire Console dashboards: per-route QA, hallucination_rate, cost_per_token, token_volume. Will add trace hook to inspect KV-cache behavior for int6 since microbench noticed a few degraded cache-hit cases.

sara_ml: One more ops tweak: start canary at 30% for first 2 hours to accelerate signal, then reduce to 15% for remainder (total 48h canary window). If thresholds breach, divert to opt13b-int8 fallback and rollback.

joel_platform: Implemented schedule in rollout: 30% for 2h -> 15% for 46h -> evaluate. Runbook updated.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 3425000005 — monitoring hooks active. :rocket: 

tina_eval: Early 6h sampling looks OK. Long summaries slightly more generic phrasing but not user-impacting yet. Will post full 24h QC.

sara_ml: Thanks — team actions: joel dashboard + runbook, tina 24h QC, sara prepare prompt tweaks (if needed). If hallucination spike, divert traffic and pause roll.

mike_prod: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for the 24h readout and any micro-adjustments. :thumbsup:
